entities.name: Aresaan
entities.description: Disgraced Boros Legion angel, once a Warleader, stripped of her wings after a battlefield decision cost fifteen thousand lives.

entities.name: Ossett Weslyn
entities.description: Newly promoted minotaur Wojek counterintelligence agent framed for poisonings.

entities.name: Embrel Skormak
entities.description: Boros sergeant who masterminded the poisonings and frame-up.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Invasion thirty years after Aresaan's disgrace.

events.summary: Thirty years before the War of the Spark, Aresaan's catastrophic decision kills fifteen thousand Boros soldiers and she is stripped of her wings.
events.quote: resulted in the deaths of fifteen thousand Boros soldiers

events.summary: Weslyn discovers she has been framed for the deaths of high-ranking Boros officials.
events.quote: Weslyn realized she’d been framed for the deaths of high-ranking officials within the Boros Legion.

events.summary: Aresaan reveals Rubblebelt dust on the minotaur guard's uniform with a spell, implicating the guard.
events.quote: revealed the Rubblebelt dust on the minotaur guard's uniform

events.summary: Aresaan vaporizes a death elixir and helps Weslyn confront Skormak, exposing him as mastermind.
events.quote: Her actions revealed that Skormak was the mastermind behind the poisonings and the frame-up.

events.summary: Aresaan extinguishes Skormak's flames, leading to his defeat and transformation into ashes.
events.quote: leading to his ultimate defeat and transformation into ashes

events.summary: Aresaan congratulates Weslyn on her promotion, showing newfound respect.
events.quote: She offered Weslyn congratulations on her promotion

relations.quote: Aresaan is a Boros Legion angel on the plane of Ravnica .
Aresaan supported Weslyn in confronting Skormak
plotting to advance his position within the Legion by creating chaos and implicating Weslyn
